text_block_list.text:
Even after finishing her run, she still 
couldn't find a dream. Yet, heading toward 
Hishi Miracle—

An old man's cheer reaches me, asking me 
to give him a dream once more. It seems 
there are people who can still find a 
dream in me, even if I have none of my 
own.

At the year-end Arima Kinen, Agnes 
Digital, as well as the book-loving hero 
Zenno Rob Roy and others await, but...

Guided by the old man's voice, Hishi 
Miracle proceeded to the Arima Kinen.
